common_brief: Photorealistic product advertisement: one red and black BLACK&DECKER cordless drill standing upright on matte oak workbench, warm soft light from upper left, softly blurred workshop background. Whole drill visible and centered, no hand or extra tools, no advertising headline, physically grounded contact shadow. Preserve actual product identity: cylindrical black chuck and white torque ring; rounded red motor body with vents; black trigger/grip inserts; slim curved integrated lower base with white LITHIUM panel. No invented bulky removable battery pack.

view_text.A: front three-quarter view looking toward the chuck; chuck points to upper right and slightly toward camera; side of red body and trigger visible
view_text.B: rear three-quarter view looking toward rounded rear motor cap; chuck recedes toward upper left; rear of grip visible

identity_checks: integrated curved base without invented battery pack
gate.primary: Clear useful structural/identity advantage over ordinary generation in BOTH views without worse scene naturalness; one lucky sample is insufficient
gate.secondary: Before/after SDXL identifies adaptation effects; not sufficient alone for adoption
gate.selection: show every first output; no cherry picking
gate.fail_action: stop this configuration without retraining or seed tuning
gate.evaluation: assistant visual review, not blinded human panel or exact camera-registered geometric certification
